task_definition.task_description: Please check the current time in New York, then look up the status of flight CA1234 and book that flight for John Doe in economy. After that, check information for Hilton Tokyo and book a standard room there for John Doe from 2025-07-01 to 2025-07-05, then find Alice’s contact details and send her a high-priority app alert saying “Hotel booked successfully.”
